jobs.occupation: Senior Brand Manager Côte d’Or BNX – Equity & Communication
jobs.description:
Communication & Campaign Leadership
 
 

• Lead integrated marketing campaigns across all touchpoints — digital and social, TV, OOH, and in-store activation. 

• Brief, steer, and manage creative agencies (strategic and activation) and media agencies to deliver outstanding work. 

• Develop and execute best-in-class annual communication plans aligned to brand strategy. 

• Track and continuously optimise campaign performance through ROI analysis and brand health KPIs (awareness, consideration, penetration).  

Brand Positioning & Equity
 
 

• Define, strengthen, and evolve the long-term brand positioning for Côte d'Or in BNX in close collaboration with the European Marketing Team. 

• Develop and safeguard the brand equity framework and visual identity guidelines. 

• Ensure consistent brand expression and consumer experience across all touchpoints.  

Media Strategy
 
 

• Own the development and execution of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Optimise media mix and budget allocation for maximum reach, impact, and efficiency. 

• Build strong, collaborative relationships with media agency partners and stay ahead of emerging media trends.  

Consumer & Category Insights
 
 

• Monitor category dynamics and brand performance using market data and consumer research. 

• Identify emerging consumer needs and translate insights into actionable brand and communication initiatives. 

• Partner with the insights team to build a deep understanding of the BNX chocolate consumer.  

P&L Ownership & Financial Management
 
 

• Own the brand P&L, including forecasting and marketing budget management. 

• Drive net revenue growth and margin performance within your area of responsibility. 

• Work closely with finance to track investment efficiency and ensure delivery against business targets.  

People Leadership
 
 

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of 2 direct reports, supporting their professional growth and performance. 

• Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture built on trust, curiosity, and ambition.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 
 

• Partner closely with category management, shopper marketing, sales, consumer insights, finance, supply chain, and legal teams across BNX. 

• Collaborate with the European marketing organisation to co-develop, adapt, and localise regional campaigns for the BNX market. 

• Act as a key contributor to the broader Benelux brand and marketing community.  

What You Bring
 
 

• Master's degree, preferably in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Minimum 7 years of FMCG brand marketing experience. Experience managing local brands preferred. 

• Proven track record in communication strategy, campaign development, and agency management. 

• Experience in brand positioning, equity development, and creative briefing. 

• Strong command of media strategy across paid, owned, and earned channels. 

• Experience leading and developing a team. 

• Benelux market knowledge is a strong plus. 

• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.  

What We Offer
 
 

• A dynamic, international work environment with iconic global brands 

• Real ownership and accountability from day one 

• A collaborative, people-first culture that celebrates curiosity and learning 

• Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including company car 

• Opportunities for regional and global career growth within Mondelēz 

• Flexible working arrangements and a focus on wellbeing

They are urgently looking for a Business Developer E-Mobility Supply Chain, with experience in Purchase, and in automotive sector. 
 

This position involves real trading activities and business transactions with partners across Asia (including Japan). They are looking for a dynamic Business Developer who can accelerate this process, drive growth, and coordinate projects effectively.

• Business Development & Supply Chain
 
• Build and strengthen relationships with Asian automotive suppliers.
 
• Manage commercial activities, customer communication, logistics, and cost calculations.
 
• Identify and onboard new manufacturing partners.
 
• Support procurement activities, including supplier evaluation, negotiations, and QCD (Quality, Cost, Delivery) management.
 
• Electrification & Market Development
 
• Develop new business opportunities for battery-related materials and EV components.
 
• Conduct market research and identify emerging technologies and innovative companies.
 
• Explore strategic partnerships and investment opportunities.

• Monitor market and competitor developments.
 
• Support business growth strategies and market-entry initiatives.
 
• Collaborate with international teams to align regional and global objectives. 

Your Profile:
 

 
• Bachelor's degree (Master's is a plus).
 
• Fluent in English.
 
• Experience in procurement, purchasing, sales, or business development IN the Automotive sector
 
• Familiarity with Genchi Genbutsu and Kaizen principles is a plus.
 
• Technical or engineering background preferred, or a strong interest in business development.
 
• Strong communication and negotiation skills in an international environment.
 
• Proficient in MS Office and other business software.
 
• Your Competencies
 
• Customer-oriented, positive, and proactive mindset.
 
• Strong analytical and business acumen.
 
• Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
 
• Fast learner with a growth mindset.
 
• Flexible and comfortable working across cultures.
 
• Team player who takes ownership and follows tasks through to completion.

jobs.occupation: Order Picker in 2 Shifts – Join a Leading International Logistics Team
jobs.description:
As an order picker working in two shifts, you’ll be responsible for efficiently collecting orders in the warehouse. You’ll work along the order picking line, carefully placing the correct products into boxes according to the foreman’s daily briefing. Your attention to detail ensures that orders leave the warehouse correctly and on time.

A typical workday starts with a team meeting where daily goals are discussed. You’ll then get to work picking orders, maintaining a clean and safe workspace at all times. You’ll collaborate with colleagues but are also able to work independently and keep calm during busy periods.

If you’re eager to learn, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a growing international company, apply now and discover the opportunities this role has to offer!

• Strong motivation, regardless of educational background

• Precise working style with great attention to detail

• Able to handle stress and perform well in a busy environment

• Blend of team spirit and independence

• Eager to learn and open to discovering new aspects of the production department

• Maintain a clean and safe workspace

• Fluent in Dutch and/or English

• Preferably 1 to 5 years of relevant experience

jobs.occupation: Lead Warehouse Associate in 2 Shifts – Grow with a Dynamic Logistics Team
jobs.description:
As a Lead Warehouse Associate in 2 shifts, you'll organize and oversee the order picking process. At the start of your shift, the foreman will brief you on the targets for the day. Together with your team, you ensure the right products are accurately picked and packed, and that all goals are met.

On an average workday, you guide your team in picking orders on the line, monitor quality and efficiency, and adjust where needed. You're the first point of contact for your colleagues, maintain order and cleanliness, and make sure everyone works safely. You'll work in a rotating shift system, which brings plenty of variety and dynamism.

Ready to use your experience as an order picker in a leadership role within an international and financially stable company? Apply today and help build a motivated and strong team!

• Experience as an order picker or in a first-line leadership role

• Motivation and accuracy are more important than your diploma

• Strong attention to detail and quality

• Able to handle stress and perform well in a busy environment

• Strong team spirit but also able to work independently

• Eager to learn and open to discovering more about the production department

• Keep the workplace tidy and prioritize safety

• Fluent in Dutch or English

Responsibilities

• Analyze business requirements and design sustainable data solutions that provide immediate value and long-term reliability.
• Contribute to the evolution of data governance methodologies by providing feedback from practical field implementations.
• Coach and advise stakeholders, including data owners and stewards, on data management practices and the use of the data platform.
• Review and maintain a transversal business glossary to ensure a common language and clear data definitions across the organization.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary product teams to align expectations and drive data-driven innovation.
• Facilitate workshops and bring stakeholders from diverse backgrounds together to converge on technical and functional data solutions.

Requirements

• You possess 4+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, and Master Data Management.
• You bring the ability to rapidly understand complex business processes and translate them into data management requirements.
• You're an analytical problem-solver with a result-driven approach and a product-oriented mindset.
• You have strong facilitation and coaching skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and IT stakeholders.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in Dutch, French, or German.

• Knowledge of Data Classification, Data Privacy, Data Security, and CIA measures.
• Experience with Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Big Data environments.
• Familiarity with Data Modeling, Data Integration, and APIs.

Are you passionate about helping organizations strengthen their digital security while enabling business growth? As an IAM Consultant within BDO’s Risk Advisory practice, you’ll help clients design, implement and optimize Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks that protect critical assets, manage risks and support regulatory compliance. Join a team that combines technical expertise, business understanding and a pragmatic approach to cybersecurity and risk management.
What will you be doing?
In this role, you’ll contribute to delivering IAM and cybersecurity projects for a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

 

• Design IAM operating models: Define IAM operating models, governance structures, roles and responsibilities that align with organizational objectives and risk appetite..
• Conduct IAM maturity assessments: Lead IAM maturity assessments and benchmark organizations against industry good practices.
• Develop IAM roadmaps: Translate assessment findings into pragmatic IAM strategies, business cases and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
• Implement IAM solutions: Assist clients in the deployment, configuration and optimization of IAM technologies, including identity lifecycle management, access governance and privileged access management.
• Support regulatory compliance: Help clients comply with cybersecurity, risk management and data protection requirements through effective identity governance and access controls.
• Design secure processes: Contribute to the design of user provisioning, role management, recertification and access review processes.
• Collaborate with stakeholders: Work closely with IT, security, risk and business teams to align IAM initiatives with operational and regulatory requirements.
• Deliver impactful recommendations: Translate technical findings into actionable insights and pragmatic recommendations for management and key stakeholders.
What do you bring to the table?
We’re looking for a consultant who combines technical IAM expertise with strong communication skills and a client-centric mindset. Here’s what you’ll need:

 

• 3 to 6 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, IT Risk, Security Architecture or a related field.
• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience with one or more IAM domains such as Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Access Management.
• Familiarity with leading IAM solutions such as SailPoint, Saviynt, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), CyberArk, One Identity, Okta or similar platforms is considered a strong asset.
• Lead workstreams, coach junior consultants and manage client stakeholders throughout IAM transformation engagements.
• Ability to analyse complex environments, identify risks and develop practical solutions tailored to client needs.
• Able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and explain complex concepts in a clear manner.
• Fluency in Dutch and English is required. Knowledge of French is considered a strong asset.

jobs.occupation: Data Functional Analyst – SQL Server & Power BI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with business stakeholders to identify and assess operational and analytics data flows.
• Translate complex business needs into detailed technical and functional requirements.
• Design and validate conceptual and logical data models in collaboration with architecture teams.
• Establish functional designs for data developments while ensuring compliance with governance and security standards.
• Oversee the testing of developed data products to ensure alignment with requirements.
• Support business users through information sessions and training to encourage the adoption of data solutions.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in data functional analysis and data flow design.
• 3+ years of technical experience with the MS on-premise stack, specifically SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
• Proven experience in data warehouse modeling using the Kimball approach.
• You possess a Master’s degree in Computer Science or an equivalent field.
• You have strong SQL skills and high data literacy.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience as a data engineer.
• Knowledge of Azure Databricks.

Responsibilities

• Manage the end-to-end address lifecycle, ensuring consistency across various network inventory and building databases.
• Develop and validate build lists for network deployment areas by reconciling multiple data sources.
• Maintain high data quality standards by performing pre-submission checks and correcting source data to meet contractual requirements.
• Build and reconcile databases for infrastructure assets, including poles and street capacity registers.
• Automate regulatory reporting processes to ensure reliable and efficient data submission.
• Support design engineering by creating validation rules and scripts using geospatial and data analysis tools.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to document workflows and share technical expertise.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data engineering within a geospatial context.
• You possess advanced proficiency in SQL for complex queries, joins, and cross-system data reconciliation.
• You bring strong scripting skills using Python and pandas for data processing and workflow automation.
• You have deep knowledge of geospatial data, including coordinate systems, spatial joins, and geometry data using QGIS.
• You have hands-on experience running and modifying ETL workflows such as FME.
• You possess a Bachelor or Master in Geomatics, GIS, Data Science, or Engineering.
• You're autonomous and proactive in resolving complex data issues and triaging tasks by impact.
• You are meticulous with address and geometry data and focus on repeatable, documented processes.
• You are fluent in French with professional knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Direct experience with PyQGIS or QGIS plugin development.
• Knowledge of regional address and cadastral references such as BeST Address, ICAR, or Belmap.
• Familiarity with telecommunications network inventories and infrastructure assets.
• Experience building internal tools with Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
• Active knowledge of Dutch.
